headline: 凯尔·豪普特曼离开NCUA后就任美国公众公司会计监督委员会委员
summary: PCAOB官方简历记载，Hauptman于8月10日宣誓就任委员，此前任NCUA主席；NCUA职务具体结束日未列明。

sources.title: Kyle S. Hauptman
sources.excerpt: Kyle S. Hauptman was appointed as a Board Member of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in January 2026 and sworn in on August 10, 2026.

sources.title: Kyle S. Hauptman
sources.excerpt: Prior to his swearing in as a PCAOB Board Member, Board Member Hauptman was the Chairman of the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).

sources.title: Kyle S. Hauptman Sworn In as PCAOB Board Member
sources.excerpt: Board Member Hauptman was appointed by the SEC on January 30, 2026. His current term will expire on October 24, 2029.
